articles.title: AWS CloudGoat EC2 SSRF Exploitation
articles.content: Cloud environments are increasingly targeted due to misconfigurations. Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) on AWS EC2 instances allows attackers to reach the metadata service, steal IAM credentials via AssumeRole, and disable CloudTrail logging.

articles.title: GCP Compute Metadata SSRF via IAM permission abuse
articles.content: Researchers demonstrated SSRF against Google Cloud compute.instances.setMetadata allowing privilege escalation when service accounts hold iam.serviceAccounts.actAs and compute instances are misconfigured.
